problem: 设$f$在闭带状区域$0\le \operatorname{Re}z\le1$上连续、内部全纯，并满足$|f(z)|\le C e^{A|\operatorname{Im}z|}$。若边界上$|f(iy)|\le M_0$、$|f(1+iy)|\le M_1$，证明对$0\le x\le1$有$|f(x+iy)|\le M_0^{1-x}M_1^x$。要求处理无界带状区域，不能直接对整个带应用最大模原理；需引入衰减因子后在有限矩形上取极限。
answer: 先假设$M_0,M_1>0$。令$g(z)=f(z)M_0^{z-1}M_1^{-z}$，则两条竖边上$|g|\le1$。对任意$\varepsilon>0$取$g_\varepsilon(z)=g(z)e^{\varepsilon z^2}$。在$x=0$上$|g_\varepsilon|\le e^{-\varepsilon y^2}\le1$；在$x=1$上$|g_\varepsilon|\le e^{\varepsilon(1-y^2)}\le e^\varepsilon$。在水平边$|y|=R$上，因$\operatorname{Re}(z^2)=x^2-R^2\le1-R^2$，结合$|f(z)|\le Ce^{AR}$可得$|g_\varepsilon(z)|\le C' e^{AR+\varepsilon(1-R^2)}	o0$。故对足够大的矩形，最大模原理给出$|g_\varepsilon(z)|\le e^\varepsilon$。先令矩形高度$R	o\infty$，再令$\varepsilon\downarrow0$，得$|g(z)|\le1$，即$|f(x+iy)|\le M_0^{1-x}M_1^x$。若某个$M_j=0$，以$M_j+\eta$替代并令$\eta\downarrow0$。
subject: 复分析
